# French Personal Income Tax (IRPP) - Barème 2026

## Source
- LOI n° 2026-103 du 19 février 2026 de finances pour 2026
- Service Public / DILA - "Impôt sur le revenu : tranches et taux d'imposition 2026"
- Verified: 15 April 2026

## Brackets (per 1 part of quotient familial, applied to 2025 income)

| Tranche | Range | Marginal Rate |
|---------|-------|---------------|
| 1 | Up to €11,600 | 0% |
| 2 | €11,601 – €29,579 | 11% |
| 3 | €29,580 – €84,577 | 30% |
| 4 | €84,578 – €181,917 | 41% |
| 5 | Over €181,917 | 45% |

## Revaluation
+0.9% (inflation-indexed per finance law for 2026)

## Quotient Familial
The tax scale is applied per part of the family quotient. The number of parts depends on family situation (single, married, etc.) and dependents.

## Example
A single person (1 part) with net taxable income of €30,000:
- Up to €11,600: €0
- €11,601 to €29,579: (29,579 – 11,600) × 11% = €1,977.69
- €29,580 to €30,000: (30,000 – 29,579) × 30% = €126.30
- Total tax: €2,103.99 (7.01% of net taxable income)
